scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @platform/types run build && pnpm --filter @platform/config run build && pnpm --filter @platform/domain run build && pnpm --filter @platform/opportunity-lifecycle run build && pnpm --filter @platform/email run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r --filter=./apps/* --filter=./packages/* run typecheck
